original.statement: The storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io changes from v1beta1 to v1, requiring a storage version migration to rewrite existing objects before v1beta1 is removed in a later release.

decision.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows that in clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io, spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage changed from true to false between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. The v1beta1 ClusterSecretStore API version still exists in both releases [ev-9889c9b8706d][ev-e08924afdc47], so it was not removed. What changed is how that served version behaves: existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. That makes a gvk subject with behavior-changed and the literal values true→false a fair reading. The change text only says a storage migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta1, so nothing fails or must be migrated in this release, and migration-required would overstate it.
